name: Residence Permit for Capital Investment (Article 26)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an investment of at least EUR 300,000 in Greece (business activity, not real estate specifically), assessed as having positive effects on the national economy.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying investment.

evidence_required.document: Documentation of the investment and its economic impact

outcome.duration_length: 2 years initially, renewable for further 3-year periods

sources.title: Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- Codification of Legislation on entry/residence of third-country nationals, Article 26 (investment-based residence, EUR 300,000, positive effects on national economy, 2-year permit renewable for 3-year periods)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. Distinct from gr_golden_visa_real_estate: this is the general business/capital-investment route under Article 26 of the codified law, confirmed directly at tier-1 via the Greek MFA's own codification document, and is NOT tied to real estate specifically. Kept separate from the Golden Visa real-estate routes since the two have different legal bases, different amounts, and different permit-renewal structures (2+3 years here vs. 5-year renewable Golden Visa permits) -- not asserted as interchangeable.
